subject: Security

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: No Content-Security-Policy header is set

evidence.excerpt: Pipeline registers OpenApi, Logging, Swagger, UnhandledExceptionMiddleware, MapControllers; no security-header middleware

findings.standard: OWASP Content Security Policy Cheat Sheet
findings.recommendation: Add a small middleware that sets a restrictive Content-Security-Policy (e.g. default-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none' for the JSON API), with a relaxed policy scoped only to the Swagger/Scalar UI paths.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: Strict-Transport-Security is not configured
findings.recommendation: Call app.UseHsts() for non-Development environments (or set the Strict-Transport-Security header with max-age >= 31536000) once HTTPS is enforced.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff is not set

evidence.excerpt: No middleware or header configuration for X-Content-Type-Options

findings.recommendation: Add 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff' to all responses via the same security-headers middleware.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: No clickjacking protection (X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors)

evidence.excerpt: No X-Frame-Options header or CSP frame-ancestors directive configured

findings.recommendation: Set 'X-Frame-Options: DENY' and/or CSP 'frame-ancestors none' on all responses, including the Swagger/Scalar UI.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: HTTPS redirection is enabled only in Development; no HSTS; HTTP-only launch URL
findings.recommendation: Call UseHttpsRedirection() (and UseHsts()) in all environments, or document and verify that TLS is terminated and HTTP is rejected at the ingress; add an https:// applicationUrl to launchSettings.

strengths.subject: Security
strengths.title: Global exception middleware returns generic ProblemDetails and logs details server-side

strengths.subject: Security
strengths.title: No CORS policy is registered, so no wildcard-with-credentials exposure exists

checkResults.subject: Security
checkResults.reason: No Content-Security-Policy header is set anywhere in the pipeline.

checkResults.subject: Security
checkResults.reason: No UseHsts() or Strict-Transport-Security header configured.

checkResults.subject: Security
checkResults.reason: Neither X-Frame-Options nor frame-ancestors is configured.

checkResults.subject: Security
checkResults.reason: HTTPS redirection runs only in Development and HSTS is absent, so non-Development HTTP is not redirected or rejected in code.

notes: Extra observations outside the checklist: OpenAPI/Scalar/Swagger UI are mapped in all environments (the Development guard in OpenApiExtensions.cs is commented out); the anonymous GET /about?show-details=true returns configuration details (hosts, usernames; passwords suppressed) and build/deploy info; TestingController.ResetTesting is [AllowAnonymous] and destructive; AllowedHosts is '*'; ResetTesting echoes response.ErrorMessage in a Warning header (repository messages seen were generic). Consider covering these under identity-access/operational subjects.
